blocks.text:
Final remarks and future work
Final remarks
• We have built a chemical kinetic model that contains the minor species CH*, OH*, H O+
3
and HCO+ and trust-worthily predicts non-premixed flame behavior at steady state.
Comparison between experimental and numerical results validated the reduced model.
• Speed up in the simulations without e-field in comparison with detailed model was
obtained (> x2).
• The size of the reduced model should be small enough to handle e-field 2D simulations.
Near-future goals
Validation of the model
• Change the burner geometry and repeat the simulation, comparing it to experiments.
• Check how the methane flame responds to an external applied e-field, comparing it to
experiments (at 1g and µg).
Others
• Repeat the mechanism reduction process with an C H detailed model.
2 4
ASGSR Annual meeting. Nov 20-23, 2019. clopezca@uci.edu - LLNL-PRES-797100 15
